entropy_mean: sum of2 unbounded Gaussian differential entropies before Box clipping, nats; not executed-torque entropy
PPO_epochs: SB3 _n_updates;4 epochs per complete episode rollout, distinct from optimizer.step calls
Adam_steps: instrumented optimizer.step invocations, not summed per-parameter Adam counters
undefined_loss_diagnostics: explained_variance can be NaN for single-transition/constant-return buffers; numeric JSON loss summaries omit nonfinite diagnostics while original ppo_logs/progress.csv retains logger output; gradients/rewards are separately checked finite
episode: one original MuJoCo terminal COMPLETE or ABORTED, never means every task succeeded
training_policy: Gaussian samples, standard SB3 Box clipping; raw actions/logp/values/advantages/returns saved
frozen_evaluation: deterministic initial/final policy means, identical nominal task; weights/Adam frozen; repeated final episode is not a new physical state
historical_random_policy: run_rollout.py uniform(-1,1), distinct from randomly initialized Gaussian PPO; historical20.165s result not combined with current policy success rate
JF_definition: original5ms executed TASK interval-start left integral of measured cuff-force norm, not a newly defined native0.25ms force objective
native_steps: 0.25ms physics integrator steps, separately counted from RL event decisions; includes commissioning/recovery unless marked TASK
